typography.heading_strategy: Poppins with tight tracking and medium to bold weights to exude a premium feel.

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Bento-style Control Room Grid for dashboard: tight gaps (gap-6), varying column spans for metrics, tables, and camera feeds.

surfaces_and_effects.cards: Use glassmorphism with subtle inner white border (1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05)) to create high-end optical clarity.
surfaces_and_effects.hover_state: Slight vertical lift (-translate-y-1) and increased border opacity (border-white/20) with smooth transition.
surfaces_and_effects.buttons: Primary buttons: solid #2563EB with text-white, rounded-lg, hover:bg-[#1D4ED8] transition-colors. Secondary: transparent with border-white/20 and hover:bg-white/5.

navigation.topbar: Sticky glassmorphic top navigation with company logo, search bar, notification bell, and user profile.
navigation.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar with glassmorphic background, containing active state highlights using primary color.

components.cards: Metric cards (Today's Entry, etc.) with Lucide icons (tinted primary), large stat numbers, and a small trend line or percentage change indicator.
components.tables: Shadcn-based tables customized with dark glass backgrounds, no internal column borders, subtle bottom border per row (border-white/5). Status pills with solid background and high contrast text.
components.modals: Vehicle Details popup using Shadcn Dialog, dark glass overlay, backdrop-blur-sm, containing detailed specs and imagery.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast ratios are met. All primary action text on #2563EB must be white.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML/Tailwind for structural layout and Shadcn components for complex interactions (Tables, Modals, Forms).
Implement Recharts for Analytics dashboard trend graphs.
Login page must feature an animated background using the login_background image or a split layout with the login form on glassmorphic card over the background image.
Dashboard should follow a dense, data-rich layout (Control Room Grid).
Apply `data-testid` universally to all inputs, buttons, and navigation links.
Use 'framer-motion' for page transitions and card enter animations.
Footer text: '© 2026 hyundai Car Showroom Management System'.
Do NOT use pure #000000. Base background is strictly #0F172A.
You are working with .js and .jsx files. Do not create or expect .tsx files.
